opening.argument: The video presents a mail-in process for Victoria's Secret Secret Rewards, with different entry dates for Angel Card holders and Pink Nation members. Its description asks viewers to send personal information to a named promotions recipient, but the stated action is a mail-in entry, not a password request, payment demand, or investment flow. The reward framing and request for personal details warrant scrutiny; neither, on this record, establishes deception, impersonation, misuse of the information, or a fraudulent transaction outcome. The available material supports an instructional discussion of a branded rewards promotion, while leaving what happens after submission unestablished.

citations.quote: I'm sharing a few simple steps to follow in order to receive FREE VS secret reward gift cards.
Full name Address Date of Birth Email address Send info to: Promotions Team c/o The Marketing Arm
angel card holders can start sending in their entries February the 13th through. February the 25th.
if you don't have an angel card, but you are a member of Pink Nation, you can start. mailing in yours five days later on February 18th.
